create_ChangeStatus: create a ChangeStatus object to track source and build file changes during an update
use_GitFetcher: use GitFetcher to clone and update a git repository to a specific revision or branch
use_ArchiveFetcher: use ArchiveFetcher to download a tarball or zip file, verify its SHA256 hash, and extract it
use_ShipitPathMap: use ShipitPathMap to mirror files from an fbsource directory to a destination with path mappings and exclusions
use_copy_if_different: use copy_if_different to copy a file only if the source differs from the destination to avoid unnecessary rebuilds
